items.title: 20.4.2 Benzene mein side chain oxidation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of side-chain oxidation (PDF 70).

blocks.text: Benzene ring se seedhe jure alkyl group ki oxidation side-chain oxidation hai. Alkylbenzenes alkaline KMnO4, tezaabi K2Cr2O7 ya halke HNO3 se aasani se oxidise hote hain. Alkyl group, us ki lambai jo bhi ho, carboxylic acid group mein oxidise hota hai, aur benzene ring salamat rehta hai: C6H5CH3 + 3[O] -> C6H5COOH + H2O (garam karne par toluene se benzoic acid).

blocks.alt: Toluene + 3[O], teer ke oopar Heat (garmi), se benzoic acid (ring par COOH) + H2O.
blocks.caption: Toluene ki side-chain oxidation (kitab ke PDF safha 70 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Reaction ke liye kam az kam aik benzylic hydrogen, yani ring se jure carbon par H, zaroori hai. Is ke baghair reaction nahi hota, is liye ring par tertiary alkyl group oxidise nahi hota.

Alkyl zanjeer kitni bhi lambi ho, us ki jagah product mein sirf aik carboxyl group hota hai, maslan C6H5CH2R se benzoic acid, aur tetralin (saturated ring se jura benzene ring) se benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid.

blocks.alt: Teen reactions, teer ke oopar KMnO4 aur neeche H+: CH2-R wali benzene ring se C(=O)OH wali ring; tetralin, yani saturated chhe rukni ring se juri benzene ring, se benzene ring jis ke do parosi carbons par C(=O)OH; CR3 wali benzene ring: No Reaction (koi reaction nahi).
blocks.caption: KMnO4 se side-chain oxidation (kitab ke PDF safha 70 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Alkanes aur benzene dono oxidation ke khilaf bohat mazboot hain, lekin alkylbenzene mein benzylic carbon reactive ho kar aasani se oxidise hota hai.

blocks.text: KMnO4 se oxidation test ke taur par use hoti hai: benzylic hydrogen wale alkylbenzene ko oxidise karne mein KMnO4 kharch hone par us ka jamni rang ghaib ho jata hai. Benzene aur tertiary alkylbenzenes rang nahi badalte.

blocks.prompt: Toluene, tert-butylbenzene aur benzene mein se kaun garam karne par tezaabi KMnO4 ka rang urata hai?
blocks.explanation: Sirf toluene: is ke CH3 group ke benzylic hydrogens hain aur woh COOH mein oxidise hota hai. Benzene ki side chain nahi, aur tert-butyl group ka benzylic H nahi.

items: Benzylic H wali alkyl side chains -COOH mein oxidise (KMnO4, K2Cr2O7/H+ ya halka HNO3).
Ring salamat; tertiary alkyl groups react nahi karte.
KMnO4 ke jamni rang ka urna test hai.
